scientific_limitations: Fixed iteration and finite p only; no growing-iterate or uniform-in-p theorem, no exact all-degree extremizer classification. The one-step p=1 case is previously known. The 1976 Jones original was not accessible in full and historical equivalences remain possible.
title: Sharp fixed-iterate Bernstein smoothing of bounded variation: Gaussian constants and median rigidity
